goal: Arrange a company's 2025 core metrics on a dashboard, with a single screen suitable for screenshotting to a presentation appendix.

canvas.alt_background_light: N/A; this card uses dark mode

header.subtitle: Enterprise-level search and RAG platform · Internal review document (illustrative data).

palette.rule: Use accent_main for main numbers, and use alert for negative/loss types but do not overuse it.

hero_metrics.count: Replace the background with a warm-colored beach at sunset: in the foreground, there are delicate sand patterns and a few small seashells; in the mid-distance, the shallow water's retreating tide line is softly focused, and in the distance, the horizon features an orange-pink gradient sky with a low sun silhouette, with no people or branded items.
hero_metrics.rule: First row with 3 equal-width large number cards + small comparative arrows (indication)

examples_filled.label: Net Retention Rate (Estimation, driven by large clients)

sub_metrics.count: Vivid magenta background steals the scene.
sub_metrics.rule: Each card has a title + a main visual + a line of annotation

examples_filled.title: MRR (illustrative curve)
examples_filled.delta: Peak: November 2025 Large Clients Cloud Concentrated Delivery

examples_filled.title: WeChat Work service account clue SLAs.

layout.structure: Hero 1×3 horizontal layout, below 2×3 card grid, bottom footer
layout.card_styling: 16px rounded corners, semi-transparent fill rgba(15,23,42,0.6), 1px #334155 border

footer.tagline: 2026: Multi-regional deployment + tighter coupling with domestic computing power (strategic slogan, not a commitment)

must_keep: 至少一张 trend 或 progress 表示变化
Several annotations in the text indicate illustrative / estimate, not posing as audited figures.
avoid: Exact replication of real report of a listed company
